source(file.path(setup_dir, "setup.R"), local = TRUE)

# Load data.

```{r, warning=FALSE}
sample <- "vhio136"
int_dir <- file.path(datapath, "integrated")
sig_root <- file.path(datapath, "DEG-signatures", "vhio136")
compartment <- "cd8_int_nn"
obj <- readRDS(file.path(int_dir, "seurat", paste0(compartment, ".rds")))
# --- RNA is joined and log-normalized in m02; only redo it if the object does not have it ---
if (length(Layers(obj[["RNA"]], search = "counts")) > 1) obj <- JoinLayers(obj, assay = "RNA")
if (!"data" %in% Layers(obj[["RNA"]])) obj <- NormalizeData(obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
required_metadata <- c("reactivity", "manual.annotation", "time")
missing_metadata <- setdiff(required_metadata, colnames(obj@meta.data))
if (length(missing_metadata) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required metadata columns: ", paste(missing_metadata, collapse = ", "))
}
# --- TRUE where a value is not missing (NA, "", "NA" or "<NA>") ---
has_metadata_value <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  !is.na(x) & !x %in% c("", "NA", "<NA>")
}
# --- TRUE where any ';'-separated token of x is in tokens ---
has_metadata_token <- function(x, tokens) {
  vapply(
    strsplit(ifelse(is.na(x), "", as.character(x)), ";", fixed = TRUE),
    function(values) any(trimws(values) %in% tokens),
    logical(1)
  )
}
# --- reactivity already carries the viral specificity (EBV/CMV) merged in m02 ---
reactivity_chr <- as.character(obj$reactivity)
has_reactive <- has_metadata_token(reactivity_chr, "Yes")
has_autoreactive <- has_metadata_token(reactivity_chr, "Auto-reactive")
has_viral <- has_metadata_token(reactivity_chr, c("EBV", "CMV"))
has_nonreactive <- has_metadata_token(reactivity_chr, "No")
has_matched_id <- if ("matched_ID" %in% colnames(obj@meta.data)) {
  has_metadata_value(obj$matched_ID)
} else {
  rep(FALSE, ncol(obj))
}
manual_annotation_chr <- as.character(obj$manual.annotation)
obj$comparison_category <- case_when(
  has_reactive ~ "Reactive",
  has_autoreactive ~ "Autoreactive",
  has_viral ~ "Viral_databases",
  has_nonreactive ~ "Non-reactive",
  has_matched_id ~ "Non-hits",
  has_metadata_value(manual_annotation_chr) ~ manual_annotation_chr,
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)
obj$category <- obj$comparison_category
print(table(obj$comparison_category, useNA = "ifany"))
print(table(obj$time, obj$comparison_category, useNA = "ifany"))
rm(
  reactivity_chr,
  manual_annotation_chr,
  has_reactive,
  has_autoreactive,
  has_viral,
  has_nonreactive,
  has_matched_id
)
category_colors <- c(
  "Reactive" = "red3",
  "Autoreactive" = "#E69F00",
  "Viral_databases" = "#3c4b99",
  "Non-reactive" = "gray20",
  "Non-hits" = "gray60",
  manual_colors
)
plots_list <- list()
gene_sets <- list()
iTAG_signature_plots <- list()
iTAG_signature_markers <- list()
```

# Time-specific iTAG signatures.

The phenotype comparisons are generated from a mutually exclusive category. Reactive and reference-database categories take priority over `manual.annotation`.

```{r, fig.width=15}
time_points <- c("pre", "post1", "post2", "post6")
comparison_groups <- c(
  "CD8_TCM" = "CD8 TCM",
  "CD8_LEF1_ZNF683" = "CD8 LEF1+ ZNF683+",
  "CD8_activated_TEM_GZMK" = "CD8 activated TEM GZMK+",
  "CD8_TEM_KLRG1" = "CD8 TEM KLRG1+",
  "CD8_TEMRA_FGFBP2" = "CD8 TEMRA FGFBP2+",
  "CD8_TEMRA_LILRB1" = "CD8 TEMRA LILRB1+",
  "CD8_activated_proliferating" = "CD8 activated/proliferating",
  "Viral_databases" = "Viral_databases",
  "Non_reactive" = "Non-reactive",
  "Non_hits" = "Non-hits"
)
# --- Reactive vs one group at one timepoint (find_markers); skips if < 2 cells, down markers get '-' ---
run_iTAG_comparison <- function(
  obj,
  time_point,
  comparison_group,
  pval_cutoff = 1e-3,
  logfc_cutoff = 1
) {
  groups <- c("Reactive", comparison_group)
  group_counts <- table(
    obj$category[
      obj$time %in% time_point &
        obj$category %in% groups
    ]
  )
  group_counts <- group_counts[groups]
  if (any(is.na(group_counts)) || any(group_counts < 2)) {
    count_message <- paste0(
      groups,
      "=",
      ifelse(is.na(group_counts), 0, group_counts),
      collapse = ", "
    )
    warning(
      "Skipping ", time_point, " / Reactive vs ", comparison_group,
      ": insufficient cells (", count_message, ")."
    )
    return(list(
      plot = NULL,
      markers = character(0)
    ))
  }
  res <- find_markers(
    object = obj,
    groups = groups,
    time_point = time_point,
    pval_cutoff = pval_cutoff,
    logfc_cutoff = logfc_cutoff
  )
  markers <- c(
    res$markers_group1,
    if (length(res$markers_group2) > 0)
      paste0(res$markers_group2, "-")
  )
  list(
    plot = res$plot,
    markers = markers
  )
}
for (time_point in time_points) {
  iTAG_signature_markers[[time_point]] <- list()
  for (comparison_id in names(comparison_groups)) {
    comparison_group <- unname(comparison_groups[[comparison_id]])
    res <- run_iTAG_comparison(
      obj = obj,
      time_point = time_point,
      comparison_group = comparison_group,
      pval_cutoff = 1e-3,
      logfc_cutoff = 1
    )
    iTAG_signature_markers[[time_point]][[comparison_id]] <- res$markers
    plot_name <- paste(time_point, comparison_id, sep = "_")
    if (!is.null(res$plot)) {
      iTAG_signature_plots[[plot_name]] <- res$plot
      print(res$plot)
    }
  }
  signature_name <- paste0("iTAG_", time_point)
  gene_sets[[signature_name]] <- iTAG_signature_markers[[time_point]] %>%
    unlist(use.names = FALSE) %>%
    unique() %>%
    refine_gene_set()
}
```

# Pan.

```{r}
gene_sets[["iTAG_all"]] <- unique(c(
  gene_sets$iTAG_pre,
  gene_sets$iTAG_post1,
  gene_sets$iTAG_post2,
  gene_sets$iTAG_post6
)) %>%
  refine_gene_set()
# --- Drop genes up in one timepoint and down in another (UCell would add and subtract them) ---
conflicting_genes <- intersect(
  grep("-$", gene_sets$iTAG_all, value = TRUE, invert = TRUE),
  sub("-$", "", grep("-$", gene_sets$iTAG_all, value = TRUE))
)
message("Genes with opposite signs across timepoints, removed from iTAG_all: ", paste(conflicting_genes, collapse = ", "))
gene_sets$iTAG_all <- gene_sets$iTAG_all[!sub("-$", "", gene_sets$iTAG_all) %in% conflicting_genes]
rm(conflicting_genes)
empty_signatures <- names(gene_sets)[lengths(gene_sets) == 0]
if (length(empty_signatures) > 0) {
  stop(
    "No genes were retained for: ",
    paste(empty_signatures, collapse = ", ")
  )
}
obj <- AddModuleScore_UCell(
  obj,
  features = gene_sets,
  assay = "RNA",
  w_neg = 0.15,
  ncores = 8
)
```

Checkpoint.

```{r, warning=FALSE}
# --- Seurat object (TRTPBL_UCell and the other signatures.tsv scores are inherited from m02) ---
saveRDS(obj, file.path(int_dir, "seurat", paste0(compartment, ".rds")))
# --- Signatures (rds and one txt per gene set) ---
sig_dir <- file.path(sig_root, compartment, "markers")
dir.create(sig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
saveRDS(gene_sets, file.path(sig_dir, "itag_signatures.rds"))
for (name in names(gene_sets)) {
  file_path <- file.path(sig_dir, paste0(name, ".txt"))
  write.table(
    gene_sets[[name]],
    file = file_path,
    quote = FALSE,
    row.names = FALSE,
    col.names = FALSE
  )
}
# --- Marker plots ---
dir.create(file.path(sig_root, compartment, "markers", "plots-radar"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
for (i in names(iTAG_signature_plots)) {
  pdf(
    file = file.path(sig_root, compartment, "markers", "plots-radar", paste0(i, ".pdf")),
    width = 24, height = 9
  )
  print(iTAG_signature_plots[[i]])
  dev.off()
}
```

### Pre

Performance

```{r}
top_clonotypes <- 100
signatures_to_compare <- c("iTAG_pre_UCell", "iTAG_post1_UCell", "iTAG_post2_UCell", "iTAG_post6_UCell", "iTAG_all_UCell", "Yossef_NeoTCR_PBL_UCell", "TRTPBL_UCell")
signatures_to_compare <- factor(signatures_to_compare, levels = signatures_to_compare)
plots_cd3 <- generate_plots(obj, "pre", "bulk", "Pre-Tx")
plots_cd3pd1 <- generate_plots(obj, "pre", c("bulk", "pd1"), "Pre-Tx")
plots_list[["iTAG_signature_pre"]] <- wrap_plots(
  plots_cd3$a, plots_cd3$b, plots_cd3$c,
  plots_cd3pd1$a, plots_cd3pd1$b, plots_cd3pd1$c,
  ncol = 3
) + plot_annotation(title = "Pre-Tx")
```

# Heatmap

Top-20 DEGs between Reactive vs Other per timepoint, with no duplicates across timepoints.

```{r}
top_n_per_timepoint <- 20
time_order <- c("pre", "post1", "post2", "post6")
assay_use <- DefaultAssay(obj)
test_use <- "wilcox"
signatures <- readRDS(file.path(sig_root, compartment, "markers", "itag_signatures.rds"))
signature_genes <- signatures$iTAG_all %>%
  unique() %>%
  .[!grepl("-$", .)]
obj_de <- obj
if (inherits(obj_de[[assay_use]], "Assay5")) {
  obj_de <- JoinLayers(
    object = obj_de,
    assay = assay_use
  )
}
available_genes <- rownames(obj_de[[assay_use]])
signature_genes <- intersect(
  signature_genes,
  available_genes
)
if (length(signature_genes) == 0) {
  stop("No genes from signatures$iTAG_all were found in the selected assay.")
}
obj_de$reactive_vs_other <- ifelse(
  !is.na(obj_de$category) &
    obj_de$category == "Reactive",
  "Reactive",
  "Other"
)
obj_de$Time <- factor(
  as.character(obj_de$time),
  levels = time_order
)
markers_by_time <- vector(
  mode = "list",
  length = length(time_order)
)
names(markers_by_time) <- time_order
cell_counts_by_time <- vector(
  mode = "list",
  length = length(time_order)
)
names(cell_counts_by_time) <- time_order
for (tm in time_order) {
  cells_tm <- rownames(obj_de@meta.data)[
    !is.na(obj_de$Time) &
      as.character(obj_de$Time) == tm
  ]
  if (length(cells_tm) == 0) {
    warning(
      paste0(
        "No cells were found for timepoint: ",
        tm
      )
    )
    next
  }
  obj_tm <- subset(
    obj_de,
    cells = cells_tm
  )
  Idents(obj_tm) <- "reactive_vs_other"
  group_counts <- table(
    Idents(obj_tm)
  )
  cell_counts_by_time[[tm]] <- tibble(
    Time = tm,
    group = names(group_counts),
    n_cells = as.integer(group_counts)
  )
  if (
    !"Reactive" %in% names(group_counts) ||
      !"Other" %in% names(group_counts)
  ) {
    warning(
      paste0(
        tm,
        " does not contain both Reactive and Other cells."
      )
    )
    next
  }
  if (
    group_counts[["Reactive"]] < 3 ||
      group_counts[["Other"]] < 3
  ) {
    warning(
      paste0(
        tm,
        " contains fewer than 3 cells in at least one group."
      )
    )
    next
  }
  features_tm <- intersect(
    signature_genes,
    rownames(obj_tm[[assay_use]])
  )
  markers_tm <- FindMarkers(
    object = obj_tm,
    ident.1 = "Reactive",
    ident.2 = NULL,
    assay = assay_use,
    slot = "data",
    features = features_tm,
    test.use = test_use,
    logfc.threshold = 0,
    min.pct = 0,
    min.diff.pct = -Inf,
    only.pos = FALSE,
    base = 2,
    fc.name = "avg_log2FC",
    verbose = FALSE
  ) %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(
      Time = factor(
        tm,
        levels = time_order
      ),
      n_Reactive = as.integer(
        group_counts[["Reactive"]]
      ),
      n_Other = as.integer(
        group_counts[["Other"]]
      )
    )
  markers_by_time[[tm]] <- markers_tm
}
findmarkers_results <- bind_rows(
  markers_by_time
) %>%
  mutate(
    Time = factor(
      as.character(Time),
      levels = time_order
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Time,
    desc(avg_log2FC),
    gene
  )
cell_counts_by_time <- bind_rows(
  cell_counts_by_time
) %>%
  mutate(
    Time = factor(
      Time,
      levels = time_order
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Time,
    group
  )
print(cell_counts_by_time)
if (nrow(findmarkers_results) == 0) {
  stop("FindMarkers did not return results for any timepoint.")
}
top_genes_by_time <- findmarkers_results %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(avg_log2FC),
    avg_log2FC > 0
  ) %>%
  group_by(Time) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(avg_log2FC),
    gene,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  slice_head(
    n = top_n_per_timepoint
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    rank_within_timepoint = row_number()
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(
    Time,
    rank_within_timepoint
  ) %>%
  select(
    Time,
    rank_within_timepoint,
    gene,
    avg_log2FC,
    pct.1,
    pct.2,
    p_val,
    p_val_adj,
    n_Reactive,
    n_Other
  )
print(top_genes_by_time)
top_gene_counts <- top_genes_by_time %>%
  dplyr::count(
    Time,
    name = "n_selected"
  )
print(top_gene_counts)
selected_genes <- top_genes_by_time %>%
  pull(gene) %>%
  unique()
if (length(selected_genes) == 0) {
  stop("No genes with positive avg_log2FC were available for the heatmap.")
}
common_times <- time_order[
  time_order %in%
    as.character(
      unique(findmarkers_results$Time)
    )
]
hm_long <- tidyr::crossing(
  gene = selected_genes,
  Time = common_times
) %>%
  left_join(
    findmarkers_results %>%
      transmute(
        gene,
        Time = as.character(Time),
        avg_log2FC
      ),
    by = c(
      "gene",
      "Time"
    )
  )
if (anyNA(hm_long$avg_log2FC)) {
  warning(
    "Some selected gene-timepoint combinations were absent from FindMarkers and were replaced with 0."
  )
}
hm <- hm_long %>%
  mutate(
    avg_log2FC = replace_na(
      avg_log2FC,
      0
    ),
    Time = factor(
      Time,
      levels = common_times
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Time,
    values_from = avg_log2FC
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene") %>%
  as.matrix()
hm <- hm[
  selected_genes,
  common_times,
  drop = FALSE
]
p <- pheatmap(
  hm,
  scale = "row",
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("#4575b4", "#f7f7f7", "#d73027"))(100),
  main = paste0(
    "Top ",
    top_n_per_timepoint,
    " FindMarkers Genes per Timepoint: Reactive vs. All Other Cells"
  ),
  cellheight = 10,
  cellwidth = 20
)
plots_list[["iTAG_signature_heatmap_top_DEGs"]] <- p
```

# Save plots.

```{r}
plots_dir <- file.path(sig_root, compartment, "performance")
dir.create(
  plots_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)
for (i in names(plots_list)) {
  out <- file.path(
    plots_dir,
    paste0(i, ".pdf")
  )
  tryCatch(
    {
      ggsave(
        filename = out,
        plot = plots_list[[i]],
        device = "pdf",
        width = 297 / 12.5,
        height = 210 / 12.5,
        units = "in",
        limitsize = FALSE
      )
      message(
        sprintf(
          "Saved: %s",
          out
        )
      )
    },
    error = function(e) {
      message(
        sprintf(
          "Skipping '%s': %s",
          i,
          conditionMessage(e)
        )
      )
    }
  )
}
```

```{r}
print("Plots saved successfully.")
```
